mutability_classes.immutable: cannot change; never offered as advice
mutability_classes.verifiable: borrower can change AND lender can verify -> allowed recourse lever
mutability_classes.gameable: easy to window-dress -> excluded from advice, watched by trust checks
mutability_classes.derived: computed from other features; recompute after any lever change

monotone_pd_convention: +1: PD must not decrease when feature increases; -1: PD must not increase; 0: unconstrained

features.name: bureau_score
features.label: Credit bureau score
features.reason_risk: Bureau score is low or missing (thin credit file).

features.name: collateral_value_ratio
features.label: Collateral cover
features.reason_risk: Collateral cover is low relative to the loan.

features.name: vintage_months
features.label: Business age
features.reason_risk: The business is relatively new.

features.name: gst_filing_regularity
features.label: GST filing regularity
features.reason_risk: GST returns were filed on time only {value:.0%} of the last 12 months.
features.advice: File GST returns on time every month.

features.name: gst_filing_delay_days
features.label: GST filing delay
features.reason_risk: GST returns are filed about {value:.0f} days late on average.
features.advice: File GST returns before the due date.

features.name: gstr1_3b_mismatch
features.label: GSTR-1 vs 3B mismatch
features.reason_risk: Sales reported in GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B differ by {value:.0%}.
features.advice: Reconcile GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B before filing.

features.name: receivable_days
features.label: Receivable days
features.reason_risk: Customers take about {value:.0f} days to pay, longer than similar firms.
features.advice: Reduce receivable days through earlier invoicing and follow-up.

features.name: upi_inflow_3m_avg
features.label: Average monthly UPI inflow (3m)
features.reason_risk: Recent digital inflows are low.

features.name: avg_bank_balance_3m
features.label: Average bank balance (3m)
features.reason_risk: Average bank balance is low.

features.name: inflow_stability_cv
features.label: Inflow variability
features.reason_risk: Monthly inflows swing widely (variability {value:.2f}).

features.name: cheque_bounces_6m
features.label: Cheque bounces (6m)
features.reason_risk: {value:.0f} cheque(s) bounced in the last 6 months.
features.advice: Avoid cheque bounces by keeping a payment buffer.

features.name: utility_delay_days
features.label: Utility payment delay
features.reason_risk: Utility bills are paid about {value:.0f} days late.
features.advice: Pay utility bills before the due date.

features.name: invoice_digitisation_share
features.label: Digitised invoices
features.reason_risk: Only {value:.0%} of invoices are digital and verifiable.
features.advice: Move invoices to e-invoicing / digital records.

features.name: inventory_days
features.label: Inventory days
features.reason_risk: Inventory sits for long.

features.name: payable_days
features.label: Payable days
features.reason_risk: Supplier credit period is short.

features.name: cash_conversion_days
features.label: Cash conversion cycle
features.reason_risk: Cash is tied up for about {value:.0f} days between paying suppliers and collecting.

features.name: supplier_concentration
features.label: Supplier concentration
features.reason_risk: Depends heavily on few suppliers.

features.name: customer_concentration
features.label: Customer concentration
features.reason_risk: Depends heavily on few customers.

features.name: revenue_growth_3m
features.label: Revenue growth (3m)
features.reason_risk: Revenue is falling.

features.name: sector
features.label: Sector
features.reason_risk: Sector carries higher risk.

features.name: udyam_category
features.label: Udyam category
features.reason_risk: Enterprise size category.

features.name: requested_amount
features.label: Requested loan amount
features.reason_risk: Requested amount is high relative to inflows.
